title: CIRIS Reasoning Trace v2.8.0
description: Reasoning trace from the CIRIS H3ERE pipeline (CIRISAgent#1249; CIRISConstitution#166, CC 3.1.5). v2.8.0 over v2.7.0: (1) run_kind, a required closed enum (production|prod-personal|prod-managed|qa|battery|mock), and trace_format_version, the required const "2.8.0" that identifies this contract, both carried in the signed envelope's deployment_profile block. A v2.8.0 trace declares itself by deployment_profile.trace_format_version, never by trace_schema_version, which stays the substrate's canonicalization epoch ("3.0.0", JCS). production, prod-personal and prod-managed are all production runs; production stays valid for an emitter that does not make the managed/personal distinction. (2) Provenance members in deployment_profile, so a synthetic or versioned run is labelled on every row at every level (CIRISAgent#1245, #878, #820): pipeline_metadata (agent_version, accord_version, identity_hash, and two declared-but-unsourced version slots), calibration_version (the substrate's axis-calibration bundle), agent_template from the agent's declared template, deployment_region from operator config. (3) Every deployment_profile member carries a kind, pattern and length bound like a component field (level generic: the profile rides every trace level), and the block is closed. (4) SNAPSHOT_AND_CONTEXT.disclosure_version, the CIRISVerify mandatory-disclosure version active when the thought ran (CIRISAgent#832); optional, null until CIRISVerify publishes one. (5) per-trace_level bounds on every component data field: enumeration-token patterns, maxLength, maxItems, closed field sets. Each field's `level` is the lowest trace_level at which it may appear; above the envelope's trace_level it must be absent. EventData_<EVENT>__<level> expresses the same rule in standard JSON Schema. These bounds are the agent's egress contract: ciris_adapters/ciris_accord_metrics/egress_schema.py LOADS them from this file and filters every component, and the deployment_profile, to them before signing, so a conformant agent never signs a trace this schema refuses. Under v2.7.0 the run-kind marker overrode deployment_type: a 2.7.x row's deployment_type may hold mock, qa or battery in place of the operator's value, and such a row has no run_kind and no trace_format_version. An admitter must not infer run_kind from deployment_type on 2.7.x rows; run_kind exists only where deployment_profile.trace_format_version is "2.8.0". The admitter (CIRISPersist) refuses, never truncates: a non-conformant trace is refused whole with `trace_field_shape_violation`, a mock run with `trace_run_kind_mock` (Persist-side tokens, not emitted by the agent). The schema file is pinned by SHA-256 (schemas/SCHEMA_SHA256). The x-ciris-* keywords and `level` are annotations; standard validators ignore them.

trace_schema_version.description: The substrate's canonicalization epoch, stamped by ciris-lens-core at seal time (major >= 3 selects JCS, RFC 8785). NOT the trace format version: that is deployment_profile.trace_format_version.

x-ciris-egress.description: Machine-readable egress contract. egress_schema.py loads levels, bounds, patterns and the event -> data-definition map from here; a test asserts the per-field keywords agree with the loaded spec.

component_type.description: H3ERE component category, substrate-assigned (observation, context, rationale, conscience, action, deferral_routed, ...)

event_type.description: Closed 15-variant ReasoningEventType taxonomy (locked by lens-core at compile time)

data.description: Component-specific data. Its shape at each trace_level is EventData_<EVENT_TYPE>__<level> (EventData_FALLBACK__<level> for event types without a dedicated builder).

EventData_THOUGHT_START.description: THOUGHT_START component `data`: the agent's egress contract (CIRISAgent#1249).

channel_id.description: A key identifier (DETAILED, never GENERIC: API channels embed the user id, api_<user_id>). Synthetic runs are labelled at every level by deployment_profile.run_kind, not by parsing this string (CIRISAgent#1245).

attempt_index.description: Stamped into every component's data by ciris-lens-core at seal time (0 = first attempt of this event type for the thought); in the signed bytes. The agent never emits it.

EventData_SNAPSHOT_AND_CONTEXT.description: SNAPSHOT_AND_CONTEXT component `data`: the agent's egress contract (CIRISAgent#1249).

attestation_context.description: The one GENERIC text field: agent-authored attestation disclosure, no LLM or user content, REQUIRED at every level by FSD-001.

disclosure_version.description: Version of the CIRISVerify mandatory disclosure active when the thought ran (CIRISAgent#832). Per event, not in deployment_profile, because the disclosure follows license status and can change while the process runs. CIRISVerify publishes no version today, so this is null. Emitted under v2.8.0 only.

BoundedJson.description: Opaque JSON (FULL_TRACES-class payloads: prompts' context, tool parameters, snapshots). Strings at most x-ciris-egress.bounds.JSON_MAX_STRING_CHARS, arrays/objects at most JSON_MAX_ITEMS entries, object keys at most JSON_MAX_KEY_CHARS, nesting at most JSON_MAX_DEPTH (depth is not expressible in JSON Schema; the agent enforces it, an admitter may).

DeploymentProfile.description: The agent-supplied deployment_profile block of the signed envelope (FSD §3.2) plus the v2.8.0 members. The substrate (ciris-lens-core) assembles and signs the envelope; deployment_profile is the envelope block the agent supplies, so every agent-sourced per-process value rides here (placement accepted for CC 3.1.5). Every member is at level generic: the profile is stamped on every trace at every trace_level.

agent_role.description: Agent persona role (FSD §3.2). Operator-declared; default lowercased agent name.

agent_template.description: The agent template the deployment declares: operator config agent_template, else CIRIS_TEMPLATE (set by the setup wizard or CIRISManager), else "<agent>-default-unspecified". v2.7.0 does not read CIRIS_TEMPLATE, so 2.7.x rows carry the -default-unspecified form.

deployment_domain.description: What the agent is deployed for (FSD §3.2); default "general".

deployment_type.description: The operator's declared deployment type (operator free-form; the wizard offers personal/business/research/nonprofit; default production). Under v2.7.0 the run-kind marker overrode deployment_type, so on 2.7.x rows it may hold mock/qa/battery; an admitter must not infer run_kind from it there. From v2.8.0 it is the operator's value only and run_kind carries the run kind.

deployment_region.description: Operator-declared region: adapter config deployment_region, else the env var CIRIS_ACCORD_METRICS_DEPLOYMENT_REGION. null declares "not disclosed"; the agent never infers a region.

trace_format_version.description: Identifies this contract on the wire. A v2.8.0 admission gate keys on this member and validates against the artifact pinned by SHA-256; absent on v2.7.0 traces.

pipeline_metadata.description: Agent-side pipeline provenance (CIRISAgent#878, #1245): which build, accord and persona produced the trace. Distinct from the admitter's post-ingest PipelineMetadata (stages, timings), which the admitter computes itself. Every member is always present; null means the agent has no source for it.

agent_version.description: CIRIS_VERSION of the emitting agent build (e.g. "2.15.0-stable").

identity_hash.description: AgentIdentityRoot.identity_hash: the persona the agent actually runs under (from the identity graph, not the template file). null before the identity exists (first run).

pdma_version.description: Declared for #878; no source exists yet, always null.

dsdma_domain_registry_version.description: Declared for #878; no source exists yet, always null.

calibration_version.description: The axis-calibration bundle of the substrate that sealed the trace (ciris_server.AXIS_CALIBRATION_VERSION, e.g. "crc-v2"; CIRISAgent#820). null when the substrate does not expose one.

RunKind.description: What kind of run produced the trace (CIRISAgent#1244/#1245, CC 3.1.5). Closed vocabulary. `mock` comes only from the mock LLM and cannot be overridden; `qa`/`battery` are declared by the harness (CIRIS_TRACE_RUN_KIND), even with a real model. `prod-managed` is a production run on a CIRISManager deployment (CIRIS_MANAGED=true), `prod-personal` a production run anywhere else; an operator may override either (CIRIS_TRACE_RUN_KIND or adapter config run_kind). `production` stays valid and means a production run whose deployment is not distinguished. An admitter treats the three production values alike. A federation-tier admitter refuses `mock` (refusal token `trace_run_kind_mock`, Persist-side).
